name: manual_2e154f
claim: DO NOT assume directory or structure names: when the user gives an explicit name (e.g. '.agent/memory'), use it verbatim — never silently 'correct' it to a guess (e.g. '.agents/memory'). If it seems wrong or you have not read its conventions, STOP and ASK first. Read the area's AGENTS.md/_index before writing.

decisions.notes: 2026-06-22 anti-pattern: I overrode the explicit '.agent/memory' instruction with '.agents/memory' rationalizing 'avoid a parallel dir', and committed there. '.agent/' was in fact the canonical structured memory system on origin/main with an AGENTS.md I never read. Catastrophic assumptions like this are the exact failure the orama AFRP method exists to prevent (know purpose first, never assume).
